data.long_meaning: Sharveeja is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Sharva' meaning victory and 'Ija' meaning goddess. Thus, Sharveeja is the goddess of victory. The name Sharveeja carries the meaning “Goddess of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Sharveeja usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
